turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Is this still a convenient time for our arranged telephone discussion?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Can. Office quite quiet now, so I've got my paperwork in front of me. Easier to talk without people coming in lah. My identification number is T two eight nine one six seven zero N. My date of birth is 31 October 1971.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. We can keep the discussion focused so you can return to your business commitments. To confirm your objective, you want to build wealth over the long term through diversified growth exposure, while moderating the fluctuations of an equity-only approach.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My assistant handles the routine filing. These calls I take myself lah. Otherwise the whole afternoon gets swallowed up already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll keep the conversation concise and leave the routine correspondence to the usual channel. I recommend Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund because its equities provide growth exposure while its bonds help moderate portfolio fluctuations. That combination fits your long-term wealth-building objective without relying entirely on equities.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me hear the rest first ah. No need for a long presentation; plain language easier for me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, the bond holdings can fall in value when interest rates rise. In stressed markets, its equities and bonds can decline together, reducing the protection diversification provides. Do you understand how rising interest rates can affect the fund's bonds, and that its equities and bonds can fall together?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the bond values can drop, and having equities and bonds together doesn't stop them from falling at the same time. Technical wording sometimes quite cheem; the plain explanation easier to follow lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me pull my notes closer. Got them here already. For this transaction, I'll go with Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to sell the units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The proposed dealing currency for this transaction is euro.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use the currency you just mentioned for my transaction lah. Got the paperwork beside me already; no need to switch screens while we're talking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time with your notes. I'll leave a moment for you to review them before I read back the complete instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Paiseh, my notes a bit untidy. Wait, I got the direction wrong earlier. Cancel that earlier direction; I meant to buy the units. The amount for this transaction is 10,000. Quantity-wise, make it 100 units. Put it through as a limit order, with the limit price at 100 euros per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Following your correction, your final instruction is to buy 100 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, with a transaction amount of 10,000 in euro, using a limit order at a limit price of 100 euros per unit. Do you confirm this final instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including my correction. Please go ahead. Office getting busy outside already, but I'm still on the line lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll arrange for the relevant documentation through the usual secure channel. Before we finish, would you prefer future telephone appointments to be arranged through your assistant, or should I contact you directly about scheduling?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Scheduling can go through my assistant. Got access to my diary, so easier to find a gap. But the actual discussion, call me directly lah. Much easier than trying to fit a branch visit around work.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that distinction for future appointments. We can coordinate the diary arrangements separately and keep the discussion with you. Thank you for your time today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel Tan. Back to the office work for me already. Speak another time.
